card.name: Maneuvering, guarding and outgrowing verbs
card.fires_on: The word piece or verb just after a prefix or verb stem like out-, guard, block and, as in outmaneuver, guard against, outgrown, maneuvered. It fires on the slot where a verb of evading, guarding or exceeding is completed.

modes.label: outmaneuver
modes.description: Inside or right after out- plus maneuver.

modes.label: guard against
modes.description: The word against right after guard.
modes.example: as a detection system to guard<< against>> dangers such as heavy metal contaminants.

modes.label: other verb slots
modes.description: Words like outgrown, driving or beyond completing a verb phrase.
modes.example: has out<<grown>> can be just as dangerous.

card.plain: It marks the middle or end of verbs about evading, guarding against or going beyond something.
